parties.respondent: The State Of Jammu And Kashmir And Others

summary: Criminal acquittal vs police recruitment suitability; benefit-of-doubt acquittal not equivalent to honorable acquittal; moral turpitude standard in disciplined force recruitment; Screening Committee's discretionary authority; technical acquittal insufficient for reinstatement; no quashing of DGP's cancellation order.
final_judgment: Special leave petition dismissed; High Court judgment upholding DGP's order confirmed.
